name: spo-set-meeting-recording-expiration
title: Set or extend the expiration date on existing Teams meeting recordings
shortDescription: Bulk-sets the expiration date on Teams meeting recordings already stored in OneDrive or SharePoint using File.SetExpirationDate, the only write path for the read-only _ExpirationDate column.
longDescription: Teams meeting recordings carry an expiration date stamped at creation from the meeting policy, and changing the policy does not touch existing files. The hidden _ExpirationDate column rejects every list item write, so this sample uses the CSOM File.SetExpirationDate method, which is what the OneDrive details pane calls. It lists each recording in a folder with its current date, then sets a new date a chosen number of days out. Works around the 5000-item list view threshold on large OneDrives by enumerating the folder rather than querying the library.
